profile.headline: Software Developer at Self-Employed
profile.summary:
• Experience: Financial, Insurance, Banking, Brokerage, Retail, Government, Manufacturing, Health Care. 
• Mainframe: COBOL, REXX, HLASM, Easytrieve, CICS, MQ, DB2, JCL, ICETOOL, CA-7, Remedy, Xpediter. 
• Business: Interpreted functional requirements, developed technical specifications from functional
requirements, designed and coded applications using z/OS Enterprise.  
• Best practices SDLC methodology: Agile. Sprint Planning, Review. Scrum, Sprint Retrospective. Jira.
• Modernization -  Kubernetes (orchestrate), Docker (containers).
• On-call support: Application problem determination and abend resolution. Root cause analysis.

• Front-end Development: Java, JScript, C#, HTML, CSS, SQL Server, Azure, Django, CI/CD, Jenkins.
• Java Microservices with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud. REST API, start.spring.io, api-gateway, Maven projects.
• SQL Development: SQL server to develop data warehouse and BI solutions. Data maps. Modeling.
• Advanced T-SQL programming. SQL queries, triggers, and stored procedures on SQL server.
• Data Warehouse: SSAS, SSIS, SSRS. Reporting and data visualization. Publish reports, dashboards.
• Performance Tuning. Handling Indexes, Query Optimization. Triggers, Indexes, User defined functions. 
• CI /CD:  Develop, maintain and support Continuous Integration framework based on Jenkins pipeline.
• Quality Assurance: Performance Testing, Automation scripts – Python, JScript. Selenium IDE, Katalon. 
   
                                       
Education: Palomar College A.A. Computer programming and analysis.
Courses: Stanford University - Algorithms Specialization.      Computer Science   2019.
Divide and Conquer Algorithms. Graph Search, Shortest Paths, and Data Structures.                                           
Greedy Algorithms, Minimum Spanning Trees, Dynamic Programming.  SP Revisited, NP-Complete. 
                              
Bellevue College – C# Certification. Bellevue College.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Mainframe z/OS Enterprise COBOL V6.2 Object-Oriented, CICS, MQ, DB2, PDSE, JCL, Xpediter. InterTest CA-7, BMC AMI Apptune for DB2. 
COBOL V6.2 - Compiler Optimization ARCH(12). All production inventory. 20% cost reduction.                     
Mainframe as a Client. IBM Mainframe Cloud Framework DB2, MQ, IBM CICS TX on Cloud (CICS TX).
IBM Cloud Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker, CLI. COBOL to Docker containers from Kubernetes.
DB2 create tables and stored procedures. DB2 RUNSTATS. SYSADM Authority. Table Sampling.
Systems Analysis: Detail Design Enhancement (DDE) into application functionality documentation. 
CICS, COBOL, MQ programming, development, testing: InterTest, Xpediter - UAT, documentation.
Developed all phases and installed: Multiple projects - COBOL and CICS, MQ, DB2 to Mainframe Client.                   
Best practices for SDLC Methodology using the Agile/Scrum process framework environment.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
LifeCom: Policy Admin maintenance, subsystems, on-call support. COBOL, HLASM.
Systems Analysis: Detail Design Enhancement (DDE) complete application functionality, pseudo code and documentation.                              
CICS, z/OS Enterprise COBOL, MQ, code fixes, diagnostics, InterTest, UAT, documentation.
Bank reconciliation: SAP G/L posting. ACH formatted banking transmissions. PGP.
Year-End Support: LifeCom. LADC, Ohio Data Center. Actuarial, Underwriting, Policy Admin systems.    
Data Mapping: Analyzed Correspondence (LifeCom) variables. Tokenized into XML tags for processing.  
Developed/Installed: Multi-source business extracts flat files, Excel. Variable format. 
Developed/Installed: Sentinel system U.S. and Foreign address tracking for Legal Compliance.
Developed/Installed: Quarterly Waterfall reports for Business Analysis. Easytrieve.  
Mainframe SAS jobs. Actuarial data extracts for reporting.  
Production implementation: Remedy. Source code management - Endevor. Job scheduling CA-7.
Troubleshooting and debugging: Batch COBOL programming and LE dump abend analysis. Xpediter.
Best practices for SDLC Methodology using the Agile/Scrum process framework environment.
Training. C# certification. Visual Studio. Bellevue College.

positions.title: Consultant - Software Developer
positions.description: Retail POS with Order Management. COBOL, Assembler, REXX, DB2 UDB 8.2, SPUFI, MQ programming. Designed the file format containing all warehouses and store inventory, WIC. Critical path was reduced to meet the target date. Large data SORT solutions. PROC conversions to in-stream. PO's, Invoicing, shipping, receiving. On-call and weekend support. SCLM – Source code management.

positions.title: Consultant - Software Developer
positions.description: Analysis of Pharmacy Replenishment Operation for store expansion project. UNIX, HP/UX Server, Perl, Perl DBI/DBD, KornShell scripting, Informix/DB. Wrote QA Perl test scripts with environment variable isolation.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer/Analyst - Contractor
positions.description:
Logical/technical design, coding, testing and implementation within CAS as an integrated system for Project Management Control System (PMCS). Online development using COBOL II, DB2, VSAM with CICS 2.3 Transaction Server for z/OS. Wrote COBOL II/DB2 programs to support batch updates.
Endevor source management. CA-InterTest online testing. Eztrieve extracts.

positions.title: Consultant - Software Developer
positions.description: Developed, coded, tested and implemented, international stock market securities and exchange indexes for web page specific translation for data extraction routines using Perl, JavaScript, and XHTML. Wrote PL/SQL Server Pages (PSP).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Cashiering system. VB.NET, Windows NT Workstation/Server and programming, with back-end DPL. The distributed program link (DPL) function enables a CICS program (client) to call another CICS program (the server program) in a remote CICS region under z/OS. TSO/ISPF, COBOL, JCL.

positions.title: Consultant - Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Converted VAX/COBOL based inventory to Perl/DBI UNIX, Oracle HP-UX database. Bash scripting. Network printing for on-demand reports. SQL access to Oracle HP-UX.
Trained support programmer on Perl coding, error and debugging techniques.

positions.title: Application Web Developer
positions.description: Project team member, designed, coded, tested, and implemented in Perl/CGI, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML. Web-based Claims processing system under Windows NT and Oracle 8i. PC client-server Claims application. Internal Audit project of in-house repository, for Java programs.

positions.title: System Programmer
positions.description: Developer for IMS resource monitoring software to maximize the efficiency of mainframe computers at Fortune 500 companies. Assembler, IMS DB/DC, TSO/ISPF, JCL. Level 1 IBM Tech Support for worldwide customers.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Project member for Cash Vault web interface in Java on OS/2 Warp 4 server.
Deployed 8 primary and mirror HP/UX servers for capturing daily DDA image processing (MICR) as Blobs. Feeds posted to the HOGAN G/L system of record and customer bank data into DB2 UDB under HP/UX.

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer ESRD subsystem for Outside Medical Services (OMS). Medicare part A and B. CICS, IMS, DB2, VSAM, COBOL. HIPPA compliant. Code set standards - 835, 837.
DB2 DBA team member database design. Lifecycle project. Batch IMS programming, problem resolution and debugging. The Developer of IMS BMP data extracts to VSAM.

positions.title: Consultant - Software Developer
positions.description:
• Primary Developer. Designed and coded programs for the Funds Management System under
  MVS/XA using CICS/MRO with Assembler, COBOL II and DB2. Designed ENQ/DEQ,
  dynamic SQL (SQLDA), and LU 6.2 for access by PC workstations using Smalltalk, an 
  object-oriented, dynamically typed, reflective programming language under OS/2 P/M.

positions.title: Consultant - Integration Specialist
positions.description: Integration project. Smalltalk, OS/2 Presentation/Manager PC, CICS, IMS, COBOL, IBM mainframe, Wang for image capturing of documents.

positions.title: Consultant - Sr Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: • Quality Assurance. MD-11 program. VM/CMS, Nomad2, REXX, Xedit Macro, Telegraph graphics.

positions.title: Consultant - System Programmer
positions.description:
• CICS region crash issue solved. Omegamon monitor. CICS region dump analysis and resolution.
• JES spool, critical impending saturation problem solved. Will cause JES to crash if not resolved. 
• Marketing department project to incorporate external vendor tapes into CICS to auto-fill applicant   information into insurance policy applications.  Underwriters workbench TSO/ISPF DialogManager.

positions.title: Consultant - Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Engineering projects. SNA/Gateway data transmissions from VAX/VMS. 
• Wrote new batch TSO command to acquire TSO job number in OS/Assembler. 
• Developed new Material Estimating application in COBOL, CLIST, OS/JCL.

positions.title: Consultant - Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Conversion of VP/CSS applications to VM/CMS. Treasury Management. COBOL, Nomad2.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: VM/CMS. Focus.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
• Wrote pseudo code and programming under IMS DB/DC in COBOL for Parts tracking implosion 
   for Amdahl 580 plug compatible mainframe computers.
